content.title: Lunch Bowl Slowdown Hits Cava, Sweetgreen Shares
content.summary: Shares of Sweetgreen and Cava declined after Chipotle Mexican Grill warned of lower demand from younger and low-income consumers, a key demographic for fast-casual restaurants.  Sweetgreen slid 6% on Thursday, bringing its year-to-date fall to 80%.  Cava fell 8%, with shares now down 51% this year.
